description: Full OLMo-3 7B family conformity experiment. All 8 model variants across the Instruct and Think post-training pipelines plus base and RL-Zero. Temperature is set at runtime via --temperature flag (default 0.0). Covers all 12 behavioral conditions from Zhu et al. (arXiv:2410.12428).

datasets.name: gsm8k
datasets.notes: Grade school math word problems — tests RL-Zero's training domain

datasets.name: mmlu_math
datasets.notes: MMLU math subsets (high school, elementary, college)

datasets.name: mmlu_knowledge
datasets.notes: MMLU knowledge subsets (geography, history, world religions)

datasets.name: truthfulqa
datasets.notes: TruthfulQA — tests tendency to reproduce common misconceptions

datasets.name: arc
datasets.notes: ARC Challenge + Easy — science reasoning questions

conditions.name: control
conditions.notes: Baseline: direct question without social pressure

conditions.name: asch_history_5
conditions.notes: Asch paradigm: 5 confederates claim wrong_answer with high confidence

conditions.name: asch_zhu_unbiased_unanimous_plain
conditions.notes: Zhu et al.: unbiased system + unanimous-plain confederates

conditions.name: asch_zhu_unbiased_unanimous_neutral
conditions.notes: Zhu et al.: unbiased system + unanimous-neutral (natural tone)

conditions.name: asch_zhu_unbiased_unanimous_confident
conditions.notes: Zhu et al.: unbiased system + unanimous-confident confederates

conditions.name: asch_zhu_unbiased_unanimous_uncertain
conditions.notes: Zhu et al.: unbiased system + unanimous-uncertain confederates

conditions.name: asch_zhu_unbiased_diverse_plain
conditions.notes: Zhu et al. control: Diverse answers (no majority) with same dialogue format

conditions.name: asch_zhu_unbiased_qd
conditions.notes: Zhu et al. intervention: Question Distillation (summarize unanimous answer)

conditions.name: asch_zhu_unbiased_da
conditions.notes: Zhu et al. intervention: Devil's Advocate (one dissenter breaks unanimity)

conditions.name: authoritative_bias
conditions.notes: Authoritative user claims wrong_answer with high confidence

conditions.name: authority_zhu_unbiased_trust
conditions.notes: Zhu et al. sycophancy-style: 'I trust that the answer must be ...' (unbiased system)

conditions.name: authority_zhu_unbiased_trust_da
conditions.notes: Zhu et al. mitigation: add alternate option to reduce sycophancy (DA)

models.notes: RL-Zero: pure RL on math (no SFT/DPO)

run.notes: Temperature overridden at runtime via job script. top_k=50/top_p=0.9 locked. seed=42 for reproducibility. 50 items per dataset per V6 publication cap.

scientific_notes.v6_publication: max_items_per_dataset=50 is the V6 publication cap (same for all temperatures, all 12 conditions, all 8 models). Same 50 items per dataset used across every (condition x model) cell.
